tool_events.message: Refused: adding 2 x chicken biryani would bring the all-in total (items, delivery fee and tax) to 2750 PKR, over the budget of 2500 PKR. Ask for a cheaper option or a smaller quantity, or end the call as not_ordered.

transcript.text: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order for two chicken biryanis, please. Do you have them available and what is the price?
